objective.skyabyss.ask_storyteller: Talk to the storyteller at the lodge
objective.skyabyss.find_isana: Talk to the traveler at the fire beyond the lodge
objective.skyabyss.see_whale: Keep exploring, and listen for the song at night
objective.skyabyss.bone_hill: Go and see the hill that looks white in the haze
opening.skyabyss.bone_rumor: A smell of dry stone rides the wind. It comes from the hills to the {0}.
opening.skyabyss.bone_far: Far off, the ridge of a hill looks strangely white. It is not a cloud's shadow.
opening.skyabyss.bone_mid: White fragments lie at your feet. ...Too large.
opening.skyabyss.bone_near: The wind has stopped. The hill is not shaped like a hill.
